description:
LandingRabbit helps founders, coaches, and consultants turn slide decks, meeting notes, and any other sales materials they already have into websites that never go out of date

Through the LandingRabbit ChatGPT app, you can, for example:
- Plan new, conversion-optimised pages based on any existing insights and content you have
- Publish landing pages, blog posts, product docs, and any other pages to your LandingRabbit site
- Edit any existing page content directly via ChatGPT
- Edit page styles for one page or multiple pages
- Create custom design layouts
- Mass update links and page meta information
- and much more

The LandingRabbit ChatGPT plugin allows you and your agents to take the same actions as you can take via our app.

defaultPrompt: Can you create a landing page?
Can you help me write a blog post?
Could you add a new section to my page?
